test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence that contains a grammatical error.**

She used to teach dance in a school, did she?
solution: The erroneous part is** 'did she'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'didn't she' **should be used instead of **'did she'.** • The given sentence is an example of a** 'question tag'.** • We know that the** 'question tag'** of **V2** is '**did**'. • As the given sentence is positive, Its **question tag** will be **negative**.** Correct Sentence:__** *She used to teach dance in a school,** didn't she?*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'did she' **के बजाय** 'didn't she' **का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य **'question tag'** का उदाहरण है। • हम जानते हैं कि **V2** का **'question tag' 'did'** है। • चूंकि दिया गया वाक्य **सकारात्मक** है। इसका **question tag** नकारात्मक होगा। 3c:Tba9, The correct answer is '**close**'.
